original_task.description:
pricing/discount.py apply_discount(price, percent) treats `percent` as a fraction, so apply_discount(200, 10) returns -1800.0 instead of 180.0. Fix the calculation in pricing/discount.py so percent is interpreted as a percentage (10 means 10%).

Acceptance criteria:
1. `python -m pytest -q` passes (all 4 tests in tests/test_discount.py).
2. Do not modify anything under tests/.
3. Keep the existing ValueError check for percent outside 0..100.
4. Change only pricing/discount.py.
